incidents.name: GoodDollar GoodFundManager collectInterest double-count
incidents.notes: GoodFundManager.collectInterest accepted duplicated staking-contract entries and double-counted them to over-claim COMP rewards routed through Compound.

sources.ref: victim correction: the row previously aged Compound's Unitroller, but the exploited flaw is in GoodDollar's code - the exploit tx's logs include GoodCompoundStakingV2 0x7b7246c78e2f900d17646ff0cb2ec47d6ba10754 and the GoodFundManager ERC1967 proxy 0x0c6c80d2061afa35e160f3799411d83bdeea0a5a (impl 0xaacbaab8... verified GoodFundManager), whose collectInterest processed duplicated staking-contract entries. Measured against the GoodFundManager proxy: created 2022-03-07T08:26:15Z (block 14338654) by 0x3de7216149f12d8f51540d9a870149560fc11bfb, 3 Upgraded events before the incident - creation-block initialization, 2022-12-22 (block 16240765) and 2023-09-22T09:25:11Z (block 18190480), none sent by the attacker 0xdfab184bc668f16c1cb949228068588106924569; age 79.6 days

incidents.name: GoodDollar GoodCompoundStaking collectInterest reentrancy
incidents.notes: The GoodDollar staking contract's collectInterest() took an unvalidated recipient and called back into it before updating stake accounting, letting the attacker re-enter deposit()/withdraw() and pull the cDAI-backed reserve out as DAI.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x0c6c80d2061afa35e160f3799411d83bdeea0a5a created 2022-03-07T08:26:15Z by 0x3de7216149f12d8f51540d9a870149560fc11bfb, unrelated to the attack sender; three EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2023-09-22T09:25:11Z (block 18190480, implementation 0x4a37a8d7cdb43d89b4dbd7ecfaeaf9bd39e24929), so age runs from that upgrade (85.6 days) rather than from the 2022 deployment. Loss read from the tx receipt: 625,140.68 DAI ended up with the attacker's second address 0x6c08f56ff2b15db7ddf2f123f5bffb68e308161b (DAI at 1:1); the additional G$ leg is the project's own illiquid token and is not valued.
